text:
Mina: quick Q — with the sidebar regroup, what should happen on deep-links like /org/blue/spaces/42/dashboards/retention? do we auto-open Dashboards and move keyboard focus to the item, or just highlight it?
Jae: auto-open + reveal. screen readers need the node exposed. aria-expanded=true on the group and aria-current on the item.
Ravi: +1 but watch page/left-nav scroll jumps. if we force focus the browser might jump and user loses context. prefer to reveal silently then focus within the nav container.
Priya: implementation idea: expand group, then within nav call `item.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' })` and then `item.focus({ preventScroll: true })`. keeps page steady.
Mina: hmm okay. UX question — if user previously collapsed Dashboards manually, should the deep-link respect that preference? my instinct: deep-link means intent, so override. but we should surface that we changed state.
Jae: override is fine. we can show a subtle banner: "Opened via link — you can collapse and we'll remember your manual setting next time." small affordance to revert.
Ravi: breadcrumbs: prefer dot separators (`Workspace 3 Dashboards 3 Retention`) visually. for screen readers expose full text and use `aria-label="Breadcrumbs: Workspace, Dashboards, Retention"`. truncation should use `text-overflow: ellipsis` + tooltip.
Priya: keyboard flow to validate: Tab -> land on first nav control -> ArrowDown to group header -> RightArrow or Enter expands -> ArrowDown into items -> item receives focus -> Enter navigates. verify with NVDA + VoiceOver. role=tree is tempting but let's try `role=navigation` + `role=list` semantics first.
NavBot: created a11y ticket A11Y-209 "sidebar deep-link reveal & focus" and added checklist item.
Mina: action items: (1) router hook maps canonical route -> nav open/select on mount (Jae), (2) implement scrollIntoView + preventScroll focus (Priya), (3) show ephemeral "opened via link" toast and remember manual collapses in localStorage (Ravi), (4) breadcrumbs copy + tooltip for truncation (Mina). I'll update Figma and add keyboard gif for the PR. tagging @Jae @Ravi @Priya :thumbsup:
